title: LearnerNow
description: GET /now of the Jetson learner, and `suggestions` in the answer to POST /events (D38): what the booster thinks the owner is about to do, calibrated by its out-of-sample record. The learner only suggests; the add-on decides through the actuator (policy, tiers, ownership, kill switch, shadow).

p.description: the record of the model's bin shrunk towards its own estimate (D35)

mode.description: by expected utility, as core/predict.py decides

earned.description: the bin has MIN_FIRES fires right on MIN_RIGHT_DAYS days
